notes.title: Mutagen Extinction v1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34475766/7b7e29e9a1b8165ac9dc5cfff1b6ba9c8b6322c1.jpg[/img]

We are pleased to present the new Mutagen Extinction update.
After almost a year of hard work, we have achieved our goals.

[list]
[*] Graphical engine renewed.
[*] Performance improvement.
[*] Character updated with new animations.
[*] New combat system.
[*] Added Quests.
[*] New tutorial.
[*] Game map completely renewed.
[*] New 3D models, including constructions, weapons, vegetation, crafting tables, etc.
[*] New system at death's door, where you can be reanimated by your fellow adventurers.
[/list]

And much more to discover.

Here you have the promotional video of the new update.
We hope you like it :)

[previewyoutube=yrzKoHG0VQk;full][/previewyoutube]
See you in Nordheim!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34475766/ee7b764aa6da77491dcd25057fd069d5d80e94db.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Next Update
notes.content:
Greetings
We are bringing Mutagen Extinction to a new and improved graphics engine, which greatly improves game performance as well as overall graphics quality.
We have improved the map of the game, as well as all the elements that compose it, giving more realism to the image and immersion.
We have added a tutorial for new players, which teaches the basics of the game.
We have added various quests offering different difficulties which can be of great help to advance in the game.

Soon we will have this update online
